slides.label: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 11.12
slides.quote:
Read income and growth
from the house of gains.
body: Parashara adds livestock, the wealth of his day.

slides.label: What lives here
slides.title: Gains of every kind
items: Money that comes in, from any side
What keeps adding up over the years
Things and chances that come your way

slides.label: Why after the 10th
slides.title:
What your work
brings home
body: The 10th house is your work. The 11th comes right after it, so it shows what your work brings back.
slides.note: Sutram’s reading, built on the classical meanings

items.head: The lover (Venus)
items.line: In Nadi she stands for wealth.

items.head: The messenger (Mercury)
items.line: He stands for friends and business.

slides.label: In your chart
slides.title:
Who sits in
your 11th?
body: Count to the 11th sign from your rising sign. The grahas there, and the lord of that sign, show how gains reach you.

slides.label: In real life
slides.title:
Your income has
a network
items: A referral, a client, a friend of a friend
This week, thank one person who sent work your way
